verses.tsw_comparator: You shall tear down their altars, shatter their pillars, burn their Asherah poles with fire, cut down the carved images of their gods, and destroy their name from that place.

verses.rationale: Makes the implied worship setting explicit without reading this as permission to destroy the LORD's sanctuary.
verses.before: “You will not do so to the LORD your God.
verses.after: You must not worship the LORD your God in that way.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall not do so to the LORD your God.

verses.rationale: Preserves divine choice, name, and dwelling without naming a later city absent from the text.
verses.before: Rather, you will seek the place that the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes to put his name there, for his dwelling, and there you will come.
verses.after: Instead, seek the place the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes to put his name there. Go to his dwelling place.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rather, you shall seek the place that the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes to put his name there, for his dwelling, and there you shall come.

verses.rationale: Retains the complete offering list and hand-contribution expression with vocabulary support.
verses.before: There you will bring your burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, contributions from your hand, vow offerings, freewill offerings, and firstborn from your herd and flock.
verses.after: Bring there your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and the contributions of your hands, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
verses.tsw_comparator: There you shall bring your burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, contributions from your hand, vow offerings, freewill offerings, and firstborn from your herd and flock.

verses.rationale: Keeps shared eating, rejoicing, handwork, and divine blessing together.
verses.before: There you will eat before the LORD your God, and you will rejoice in all the work of your hands, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.
verses.after: There you and your households will eat before the LORD your God and rejoice in everything you have put your hands to, because the LORD your God has blessed you.
verses.tsw_comparator: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all the work of your hands, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

verses.rationale: Preserves Moses' inclusion of the present community in the comparison without turning it into a timeless rejection of all judgment.
verses.before: You will not do according to all that we are doing here today, each person whatever is right in his own eyes,
verses.after: You must not continue doing what we do here today, each person doing whatever seems right in their own eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall not do according to all that we are doing here today, each person whatever is right in his own eyes,

verses.rationale: Retains both rest and inheritance as the explanation of the present situation.
verses.before: for until now you have not come to the rest and to the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.after: For you have not yet reached the rest and inheritance the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.tsw_comparator: for until now you have not come to the rest and to the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.

verses.rationale: Keeps crossing, settlement, rest, and security in sequence.
verses.before: But when you cross the Jordan and live in the land that the LORD your God gives you as an inheritance, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you so that you live securely,
verses.after: You will cross the Jordan and live in the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance. He will give you rest from all your enemies around you, and you will live securely.
verses.tsw_comparator: But when you cross the Jordan and live in the land that the LORD your God gives you as an inheritance, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you so that you live securely,

verses.rationale: Retains the repeated chosen-name dwelling and the full list, including the choice quality of vowed offerings.
verses.before: then to the place that the LORD your God will choose to make his name dwell there, there you will bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, contribution from your hand, and all your choice vow offerings that you vow to the LORD.
verses.after: Then bring everything I command you to the place the LORD your God will choose for his name to dwell: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and the contributions of your hands, and all the choice offerings you vow to the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: then to the place that the LORD your God will choose to make his name dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, contribution from your hand, and all your choice vow offerings that you vow to the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves both sexes, explicit enslaved status, and the Levite's inclusion and stated need.
verses.before: You will rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male servants and female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance with you.
verses.after: Rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female slaves, and the Levite within your gates, who has no share or inheritance with you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male servants and female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance with you.

verses.rationale: Renders the place-one-sees idiom naturally while keeping the restriction specific to burnt offerings.
verses.before: “Guard yourself, lest you offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see.
verses.after: Be careful not to offer your burnt offerings just anywhere you see fit.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Guard yourself, lest you offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see.

verses.rationale: Retains the chosen location and repeated there rather than introducing a named sanctuary.
verses.before: Rather, in the place that the LORD will choose in one of your tribes, there you will offer your burnt offerings, and there you will do all that I command you.
verses.after: Offer them at the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribes. There you must do everything I command you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rather, in the place that the LORD will choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

verses.rationale: Distinguishes ordinary slaughter from offerings and makes clean/unclean diners, not forbidden species, the referents.
verses.before: “Yet according to all the desire of your life, you may slaughter and eat meat within all your gates, according to the blessing of the LORD your God that he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat it, as the gazelle and as the deer.
verses.after: You may, however, slaughter animals and eat meat in any of your towns whenever you desire, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Both the unclean and the clean may eat it, as they would gazelle or deer.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Yet according to all the desire of your life, you may slaughter and eat meat within all your gates, according to the blessing of the LORD your God that he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat it, as the gazelle and as the deer.

verses.rationale: Preserves the exception and concrete disposal comparison.
verses.before: Only you will not eat the blood; you will pour it out upon the ground like water.
verses.after: But you must not eat the blood. Pour it on the ground like water.
verses.tsw_comparator: Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out upon the ground like water.

verses.rationale: Retains the full restricted list, distinct from permitted ordinary meat.
verses.before: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, new wine, or oil, or the firstborn of your herd or flock, or any of your vow offerings that you vow, or your freewill offerings, or the contribution of your hand.
verses.after: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain, new wine, or oil, the firstborn of your herds and flocks, any offerings you have vowed, your freewill offerings, or the contributions of your hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, new wine, or oil, or the firstborn of your herd or flock, or any of your vow offerings that you vow, or your freewill offerings, or the contribution of your hand.

verses.rationale: Keeps every participant and the location of the sacred meal, followed by shared joy in work.
verses.before: Rather, you will eat them before the LORD your God in the place that the LORD your God will choose—you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates—and you will rejoice before the LORD your God in all the work of your hands.
verses.after: Eat these before the LORD your God at the place he will choose—you, your son and daughter, your male and female slave, and the Levite within your gates. Rejoice before the LORD your God in everything you put your hands to.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rather, you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place that the LORD your God will choose—you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates—and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all the work of your hands.

verses.rationale: Preserves the enduring protection for the landless Levite.
verses.before: Guard yourself, lest you abandon the Levite all your days upon your land.
verses.after: Be careful not to neglect the Levite as long as you live in your land.
verses.tsw_comparator: Guard yourself, lest you abandon the Levite all your days upon your land.

verses.rationale: Keeps expanded territory, expressed appetite, and permission without turning it into a command to eat meat.
verses.before: “When the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he spoke to you, and you say, ‘I will eat meat,’ because your life desires to eat meat, according to all the desire of your life you may eat meat.
verses.after: When the LORD your God enlarges your territory as he promised, and you say, ‘I want to eat meat,’ because you crave it, you may eat meat whenever you desire.
verses.tsw_comparator: “When the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he spoke to you, and you say, ‘I will eat meat,’ because your life desires to eat meat, according to all the desire of your life you may eat meat.

verses.rationale: Preserves the distance condition and prior-command reference without inventing an unstated slaughter procedure.
verses.before: If the place that the LORD your God chooses to put his name there is too far from you, then you may slaughter from your herd and flock that the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your gates according to all the desire of your life.
verses.after: If the place the LORD your God chooses to put his name is too far from you, you may slaughter from the herds and flocks the LORD has given you, as I commanded you, and eat in your towns whenever you desire.
verses.tsw_comparator: If the place that the LORD your God chooses to put his name there is too far from you, then you may slaughter from your herd and flock that the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your gates according to all the desire of your life.

verses.rationale: Keeps both animal comparisons and the explicit together of the diners.
verses.before: Just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you may eat it. The unclean and the clean alike may eat it.
verses.after: Eat it as you would gazelle or deer. The unclean and the clean may eat it together.
verses.tsw_comparator: Just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you may eat it. The unclean and the clean alike may eat it.

verses.rationale: Retains emphatic restraint and the life-blood identification rather than replacing it with modern biology.
verses.before: Only be strong not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you will not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.after: But be firm about not eating the blood, because the blood is the life. You must not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.tsw_comparator: Only be strong not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the flesh.

verses.rationale: Preserves the deliberate repeated blood prohibition and disposal instruction.
verses.before: You will not eat it; you will pour it out upon the ground like water.
verses.after: Do not eat it. Pour it on the ground like water.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out upon the ground like water.

verses.rationale: Keeps another repetition and the intergenerational benefit tied to right conduct.
verses.before: You will not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.after: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the LORD's eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retains the distinction between sacred gifts and ordinary local meat.
verses.before: “Only your holy things that belong to you and your vow offerings you will take and go to the place that the LORD will choose.
verses.after: But take your holy gifts and your vow offerings and go to the place the LORD will choose.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Only your holy things that belong to you and your vow offerings you shall take and go to the place that the LORD will choose.

verses.rationale: Clarifies the contrast between whole burnt offerings and sacrifices with edible flesh while preserving blood on the altar.
verses.before: You will offer your burnt offerings, flesh and blood, on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your sacrifices will be poured out against the altar of the LORD your God, and you may eat the flesh.
verses.after: Offer your burnt offerings, flesh and blood, on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured on the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat their flesh.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall offer your burnt offerings, flesh and blood, on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out against the altar of the LORD your God, and you may eat the flesh.

verses.rationale: Keeps careful hearing, enduring family welfare, and both good and right.
verses.before: Guard and listen to all these words that I command you, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
verses.after: Listen carefully to all these words I command you, so that it may go well with you and your children after you forever, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Guard and listen to all these words that I command you, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.

verses.rationale: Preserves the temporal condition and repeated dispossession leading to settlement.
verses.before: “When the LORD your God cuts off before you the nations whom you are entering to dispossess, and you dispossess them and live in their land,
verses.after: When the LORD your God cuts off before you the nations you are entering to dispossess, and you have dispossessed them and settled in their land,
verses.tsw_comparator: “When the LORD your God cuts off before you the nations whom you are entering to dispossess, and you dispossess them and live in their land,

verses.rationale: Keeps the snare warning and the imitative purpose of the inquiry, without broadening it into a ban on all historical study.
verses.before: guard yourself, lest you be ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed before you, and lest you inquire concerning their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their gods? I also will do likewise.’
verses.after: be careful not to be ensnared by following them after they have been destroyed before you. Do not inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their gods? I will do the same.’
verses.tsw_comparator: guard yourself, lest you be ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed before you, and lest you inquire concerning their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations serve their gods? I also will do likewise.’

verses.rationale: Retains explicit child burning, both sons and daughters, and the stated prohibition of imitating it in worship of the LORD.
verses.before: You will not do so to the LORD your God, for every detestable thing that the LORD hates they have done for their gods. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire for their gods.
